request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:SHIPYARD

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the green grass slab and the brown dirt under the boathouse, the boat and the crane, so they stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them. Repaint the brown boat hull and brown timbers in pale straw-yellow birch wood. Keep the red tile roofs, the cream walls, the pale crane with its rope and steel hook, outline and art style exactly the same.
